## ⭐ Google Maps locality verification sweep

For **every single suburb you listed**, I will check:

### **What exactly will I verify:**

* Does Google Maps recognise it as a **locality**, **suburb**, or **neighbourhood**?

* Is it an **estate-only name** (bad)?

* Is it only a **marketing name** from property sites (iffy)?

* Is it an **officially mapped geographic area** (good)?

* Does it autocomplete inside Google Business Profile’s service-area field?

* Does Google collapse it into a larger parent suburb (e.g., “Upper Constantia” → “Constantia”)?

* Does Google reject the name entirely?

### **What I’ll output:**

A fully verified, colour-coded list:

* **✅ Perfect** — Use confidently in GBP \+ ads

* **⚠️ Caution** — Name exists, but Google Maps it under the parent area

* **❌ Do not use** — Not a real neighbourhood in Google’s database

This will give you the **gold standard service-area list** for:

* Google Business Profile

* Google Ads location targeting

* Meta Ads location targeting.

* Your website SEO “Areas We Serve”

Your targeting will be *surgical*.

# ⭐ SET UP GOOGLE CALL TRACKING (GBP \+ Ads)

# **⭐ SET UP GOOGLE CALL TRACKING (GBP \+ Ads)**

## **1\. Turn on Call History inside Google Business Profile**

This is the built-in Google call tracking for organic (free) calls.

### **Steps:**

1. Go to **business.google.com**

2. Open **Cape Plaster and Pools**

3. Go to **Calls**

4. Click **Turn On**

5. Allow **Call History**

**What this does:**

* Google shows a tracking number on your GBP

* Calls still come to your real number.

* Your call log shows:

  * Missed calls

  * Answered calls

  * Call times

  * Caller numbers

* You can return calls easily.

* Massive boost for performance tracking

**IMPORTANT:**  
Your real number stays safe. Google only swaps it visually on Maps.

---

## **2\. Turn on “Call Reporting” for Google Ads**

This tracks calls that come from **paid ads** only.

### **Steps:**

1. Go to **Google Ads**

2. Go to **Settings** (left sidebar, bottom)

3. Click **Account Settings**

4. Click **Call Reporting**

5. Turn ON “Report calls from ad.s.”

**This lets you:**

* Track how many calls ads generated

* See call duration

* See which keyword triggered the call.l

* Optimize ads based on call results.

---

## **3\. Add a Call Extension (if you run Google Ads later)**

This makes your ads show your phone number as a click-to-call button.

### **Steps:**

1. Google Ads → **Ads & Assets**

2. Assets → **Call**

3. Add your number: \+27 76 612 5035

4. Turn ON “Use call reporting.”

Done.

---

## **4\. Add Website Call Tracking Using Google Tag Manager (optional, later)**

This is for tracking “click to call” from your website.

### **Save this for when your site is finished.**

When you're ready, I’ll give you the exact GTM tags for:

* Call link clicks

* WhatsApp button clicks

* Contact form submissions
